description: Charge Atlas helps you find EV charging stations worldwide from inside ChatGPT. Search by place, coordinate, map viewport, or route, then filter by charger speed, connector type, vehicle compatibility, and charging network. Results open in an interactive map and include source coverage context from NREL and Open Charge Map.

defaultPrompt: Show all DC fast charging stations in central London on the map.
